saw_lines: Whitening buyers rarely pick by brand. They try one strip or kit, then rebuy when results fade or stop when sensitivity bites.
So the sale is won in the first line, before a viewer decides whether a kit is worth a click.
Your site shows 10,000+ reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number. Put the 10,000+ on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 10,000+ reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so a cold viewer has no reason to trust a veneer kit. Put 10,000+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers an extra 10% off your first subscription order, yet only 2 of 27 ads mention it, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 10% first order offer in line one of three new ads.

5 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product on screen. A visitor has to hunt for the kit, and many leave first. Point those 5 ads to the exact product or collection each one shows.

Your 27 copy ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest leads 5 of them. No single hook gets repeated enough to stick. Keep the good news and daily care openers and build the next batch from those two.

ads_1: Review creative with the 10% first order offer, replacing the repeated good news opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
